principle: 全部功能纯键盘可完成；可选快捷键关闭不影响可达性

paths.entry: Tab 到插入按钮 → Enter/Space
paths.operation: Tab/Shift+Tab 浏览 IDC 与示例
paths.cancelAndFocus: Escape 关闭，回插入按钮
paths.evidenceRequired: real-browser-keyboard; native-picker/download additionally OS integration where applicable

paths.entry: 插入菜单 → Tab 到目标 IDC → Enter/Space
paths.operation: 把目标 IDC 写入保留的源选区，回编辑器
paths.cancelAndFocus: 一次正文 undo 可撤销
paths.evidenceRequired: real-browser-keyboard; native-picker/download additionally OS integration where applicable

paths.entry: 编辑器聚焦且可编辑，按住Alt
paths.operation: 按住Alt时在光标旁显示17项SVG和名称；按方向/助记键插入对应IDC。对应关系见docs/KEYBOARD.md；设置可关闭，插入面板按钮始终可用
paths.cancelAndFocus: 松开Alt、Escape、失焦或切入只读视图即收起；Shift扩选、Ctrl/Cmd编辑、IME及AltGraph保持原行为；热键冲突时按钮仍可用
paths.evidenceRequired: registry-unit-tests; real-browser-keyboard; physical-keyboard-and-OS-shortcut-conflict; native-IME

paths.feature: Shift字母偏旁快捷插入试验
paths.entry: 编辑器聚焦且可编辑，无IME组合
paths.operation: 纯Shift+F插入一个扌；该快捷键是应用的明确映射，不把小鹤obf多候选压成单一官方输出；用户可在设置关闭
paths.cancelAndFocus: Ctrl+Shift+F、Shift+方向、IME/229、AltGraph和额外修饰保持宿主行为；按钮选择仍可用，正文撤销恢复原文
paths.evidenceRequired: registry-unit-tests; controlled-browser-keyboard; native-Rime-and-physical-keyboard

paths.entry: 插入菜单 → Tab 到示例 → Enter/Space
paths.operation: 按现有明确插入语义操作，不偷换正文
paths.cancelAndFocus: 一次正文 undo
paths.evidenceRequired: real-browser-keyboard; native-picker/download additionally OS integration where applicable

paths.entry: Tab 到编辑器
paths.operation: 左右/Shift/词与行导航按视图和单位；Enter 换行，Tab 离开
paths.cancelAndFocus: Escape 收起上下文，不丢正文
paths.evidenceRequired: real-browser-keyboard; native-picker/download additionally OS integration where applicable

paths.entry: 编辑器有效选区
paths.operation: 平台 Ctrl/Cmd+C/X/V；preview 仅复制，不删
paths.cancelAndFocus: 失败保留源内容，成功不伪报
paths.evidenceRequired: real-browser-keyboard; native-picker/download additionally OS integration where applicable

paths.entry: 编辑器 Ctrl/Cmd+Z/Shift+Z 或更多按钮
paths.operation: Tab 到撤销/重做 → Enter/Space；只读禁用
paths.cancelAndFocus: 恢复 source selection，不改偏好
paths.evidenceRequired: real-browser-keyboard; native-picker/download additionally OS integration where applicable

paths.entry: 保留编辑器选区 → 更多 → Tab 到拆/合
paths.operation: Enter/Space；可选局部快捷键；默认 off 仍可达
paths.cancelAndFocus: 失败保持范围；一次正文 undo
paths.evidenceRequired: real-browser-keyboard; native-picker/download additionally OS integration where applicable

paths.entry: Tab 到视图控件
paths.operation: 原生箭头选择/确认，所有模式可达
paths.cancelAndFocus: 保留源范围；预览返回恢复
paths.evidenceRequired: real-browser-keyboard; native-picker/download additionally OS integration where applicable

paths.entry: Tab 到单位控件或设置中搜索 光标

paths.cancelAndFocus: source 不变
paths.evidenceRequired: real-browser-keyboard; native-picker/download additionally OS integration where applicable

paths.entry: 更多 → 设置 → Enter/Space
paths.operation: 焦点进入搜索；Tab 遍历结果和固定操作

paths.evidenceRequired: real-browser-keyboard; native-picker/download additionally OS integration where applicable

paths.entry: 搜索/Tab 到任一设置

paths.feature: 单项/全部默认及配置撤销重做

paths.feature: 全部菜单/详情/帮助关闭
paths.entry: 任一面板内

globalAcceptance: Tab 与 Shift+Tab 顺序合理，无非模态焦点陷阱
可见焦点与可访问名称，禁用原因可获得
不以 setInputFiles 代替原生 picker 键盘验收
所有支持平台分别记录浏览器/OS/IME 与结果
不全局截获系统、浏览器、IME 或无关输入域快捷键
每轮 CHANGELOG/产品文档/规格/验收证据同步
